text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action from today’s four Serie A games, building up to Roma vs. Sassuolo, after Cagliari-Frosinone, Torino-Lecce and local derby Parma vs. Bologna.
We begin at 14.00 GMT (15.00 CET) with high-flying Frosinone visiting Cagliari and Torino up against Lecce, then at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET) there’s the Emilia-Romagna Derby at the Stadio Tardini.
At 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET), Roma try to shake off the Manchester United debacle and keep up in the Scudetto race against Alberto Aquilani’s Sassuolo.
- All
- Favourites 0
VAR quickly points out that was outside the box, so it’s a free kick.
That looks outside the penalty area, surely?
Bernardeschi ran into the area and got into a tangle with Mandela Keita.
The siege finally pays off against 10 men!
Inverting the wingers worked, Cambiaghi gets down the right and stands up the cross from the by-line, defender Theate has followed the move and is ready for the diving header from six yards!
Mbangula stands up a cross from the left by-line, but Cambiaghi’s header is central and Daffara can capture it! He was alone, that would’ve been in with the tiniest bit of angle to it…
Bernardeschi is now on the left and he nearly scores with a spectacular volley at the back post on Cambiaghi’s cross, but another big Daffara save!
Bologna change too, Orsolini on, replacing Zortea.
Britschgi and Elphege getting ready for Parma. Elphege has been out for a while after appendicitis.
Cremaschi and Lontani off.
Parma hanging on down to 10 men after 9 minutes for the Ndiaye red card.
Odgaard down the right causing all sorts of problems, mad scramble in the box.
Into 4 minutes of added time after a red card and two forced substitutions.
Troilo into the book for a lunge from behind on Mbangula.
Odgaard turns Troilo and flashes it across the face of goal, Pobega gets on the end of it and another Daffara save!
This is a weird one.
Bologna were awarded a corner, but the ball didn’t actually go out of play…
Troilo knocked it back to Daffara, who picked it up, which he shouldn’t have done, but it was considered an involuntary gesture.
Hmm.
Odgaard gets away from Troilo at the by-line and tests Daffara at the near post!
Mbangula curler from just inside the area, Daffara flies to palm it out from under the bar!
Miranda off injured, Mbangula on. Attacking move, but then they are against 10 men.
It’s 10 against 10 right now, Lontani first dribbles through a crowd and is blocked off, then Valeri drills wide from distance.
This game is eventful, not in a good way.
Juan Miranda is hurt for Bologna and has already left the field.
Parma down to 10 men inside the first 10 minutes 🟥
Abdoulaye Ndiaye is sent off for denying a goal-scoring opportunity, leaving Parma with a huge uphill battle in the Derby dell’Emilia 😳
Stream Serie A on @paramountplus 📺 https://t.co/80AZwpx27G
— CBS Sports Golazo ⚽️ (@CBSSportsGolazo) November 7, 2026
Parma close even down to 10 men, Delprato header on the free kick loops just wide of the far post!
Romero off, El Bilal Toure’ on.
Romero has dislocated the shoulder, it’s immediately put in a makeshift sling as he goes off.
Parma need to get a sub ready.
Romero taken down by Casale sliding tackle, the defender is booked, but the striker looks concerned after landing very badly on his shoulder.
Long ball falls to the back post, Miranda on the volley that was on target, but Cremaschi made the block.
On the resulting corner, another Casale header skims the bar.
Odgaard header turned wide for Bologna.
digest_he:
מחזור משחקים דרמטי התקיים במסגרת הסרייה אה, וכלל בין היתר את המפגש האזורי בין פארמה ובולוניה באצטדיון טארדיני. המשחק קיבל מפנה חד כבר בדקות הראשונות כאשר עבדולאיי נדיאיה מפארמה ספג כרטיס אדום ישיר והותיר את קבוצתו בעשרה שחקנים בשלב מוקדם של ההתמודדות. למרות החיסרון המספרי, פארמה הצליחה להקשות על היריבה, אך שחקנים נוספים כמו חואן מירנדה ורומרו נפצעו במהלך ההתמודדות ונאלצו לצאת.

במקביל, התקיימו משחקים נוספים בליגה בהם קליארי פגשה את פרוזינונה וטורינו שיחקה מול לצ'ה, כאשר בהמשך הערב רומא התכוננה למשחקה מול ססואלו של אלברטו אקווילאני במטרה להתאושש מתוצאות קודמות ולהישאר קרובה לצמרת הטבלה. צוותי השיפוט וה-VAR נדרשו להתערב במספר אירועים במהלך המשחקים, כולל פסילות שערים ובחינת עבירות סמוך לרחבה.
